results.name: An existing schema 6 installation migrates without losing content or chosen settings
Settings has organized navigation and a responsive profile manager
Create and rename a profile with a stable identity and independent data
A task reference photo and notes belong to the new profile
Delete asks first, can be cancelled, and keeps the full profile in Recently deleted
Backups include deleted profiles and their photos, and restoration retains photo bytes
ChatGPT sees custom profile names and creates a task in the selected custom list
Deleting a profile while ChatGPT edits a task offers one profile conflict and cloud choice restores local references
Remote profile deletion conflicting with a local edit preserves the whole profile until the local choice
A remote profile deletion with no local edits keeps every local photo and note in Recently deleted
Permanent removal requires an explicit checkbox and does not affect another profile
The profile switcher, Tasks, Links and settings remain usable at desktop and phone widths
Calendar, exam plans, templates, progress and the other dashboard panels remain accessible
